claims: Creighton University is a private Jesuit institution in Omaha, Nebraska.
Creighton University has a 79.8% acceptance rate.
Creighton University features a 13:1 student-faculty ratio.
Creighton University focuses on holistic review for its roughly 4,000 undergraduates.
Creighton University offers programs in arts and sciences, business, law, and health sciences.
Creighton University is ranked #117 out of 436 National Universities by U.S. News.
Billy Bluejay is the mascot of Creighton University.
Billy Bluejay represents Creighton University in NCAA Division I athletics.
Creighton University has a 6-year graduation rate around 80%
